title: Reverse Linked List
statement:
Given the head of a singly linked list, reverse the list and return the reversed list's head.

You must reverse the list in-place by modifying the next pointers of each node.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is in the range [0, 5000]
jsonFriendlyReason: Requires ListNode adapter for head parameter and return type; linked list structure cannot be directly represented in JSON.
